findings.title: Role grants the resource in another API group
findings.cause: container watcher exits because the API server refuses its ServiceAccount deployer: it may not list deployments.apps in namespace kd-rbac-wrong-api-group. Role deployment-reader grants get, list, watch on deployments, but in apiGroups [""], and deployments are in API group "apps", so the rule never matches; its log says: "Error from server (Forbidden): deployments.apps is forbidden: User \"system:serviceaccount:kd-rbac-wrong-api-group:deployer\" cannot list resource \"deployments\" in API group \"apps\" in the namespace \"kd-…"; Deployment rollout-watcher has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container watcher exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container watcher's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail: Error from server (Forbidden): deployments.apps is forbidden: User "system:serviceaccount:kd-rbac-wrong-api-group:deployer" cannot list resource "deployments" in API group "apps" in the namespace "kd-rbac-wrong-api-group"

evidence.what: Role deployment-reader, bound by RoleBinding deployer-reads-deployments: apiGroups [""], resources ["deployments"], verbs ["get", "list", "watch"]
evidence.command: kubectl get role deployment-reader -n kd-rbac-wrong-api-group -o jsonpath='{.rules}'

evidence.what: RoleBinding deployer-reads-deployments grants Role deployment-reader to ServiceAccount deployer

findings.fix: Set apiGroups to ["apps"] in the rule of Role deployment-reader that names deployments (kubectl api-resources shows each resource's group).
